title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: MC > CD > EAC > WAV > SHN, FOB w/ two Sennheiser MD-441's (8 1/2' Stand) > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell MX-90 Cassettes w/ Dolby B). A->D (Ohr): Master Cassette > Nakamichi Dragon > HHB CDR 830 Plus > EAC -> CD Wave> flip splice

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a scorching Ventura night featuring a smoking Crazy Fingers, fiery Loser and a joyous Satisfaction > Broken‑Down encore.
ai_review.review: The show bursts with high‑energy beach vibes – Phil “on fire” from the opening, Jerry wailing through his solos, and the crowd chanting for an extra set. Highlights include a long‑awaited Crazy Fingers, a monster Loser, and a fun Satisfaction into Broken‑Down Jam encore. The front‑of‑board soundboard tape is clear and lively, making the performance easy to relive.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) emphasize a stellar performance and a clean soundboard recording; the weighting of show quality (70%) drives the rating toward the top end.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note a clear, kind front‑of‑board capture with little ambient noise; some reviewers prefer other boards but overall describe it as crisp and enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Beach‑side atmosphere fuels a tight, high‑energy set; the second half lifts off with Crazy Fingers and rides through a joyous encore after crowd chants for one more set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Wailing guitar work; solos described as remarkable throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: On fire from start to finish, booming bass that drives the performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides solid rhythm guitar, noted playing alongside guest John Cipollina on much of the second set.
